deficiencies.description: The rewrite replaces 'adolescence' with 'differentiation', altering the developmental stage referred to by the lecturer.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because obviously during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.caseForHarm: A student misses the lecturer's explicit reference to adolescence as a key period of growth and maturation occurring after birth.
deficiencies.caseAgainstHarm: The lecturer's phrase 'this occurs' referred back to development and differentiation, so the rewrite simply restates the underlying biological processes that continue from infancy to adulthood.
